help_excerpt: Data directory: ~/.bellman/ (timers.db, logs/, slots/, timers/; %USERPROFILE%\.bellman\ on Windows). The desktop app uses its own per-OS app-data dir instead — see docs/LOCAL.md.
Defaults to `$BELLMAN_DB` when set, else `~/.bellman/timers.db`; the data directory (logs/, slots/, timers/) is the database's parent.
